Ongoing problem which has landed me in the Victoria for a week under blue light delivery. Attended the surgery in person and was told someone would phone me. They did and I had an appointment 2 hours later. I don't know the doctor. He asked what was wrong and then replied "what do you want me to do?"  He waffled on for a while but saying nothing. I got up and left. Over the previous week I had seen two different nurses and had been prescribed a very potent steroid cream. Worked immediately but the condition has spread. Where does one go from here?  Been a patient here for 70 years when Dr Morris was my doctor and then joined by Dr Alan Alexander. Lately Dr Scully but she retired last month.
